user.title: Connect your Basic-Fit account
user.description:
1. Open this link in your browser and sign in to Basic-Fit:

[Sign in to Basic-Fit]({authorize_url})

2. After signing in, your browser is redirected to a page that will not load (an address starting with `com.basicfit.trainingapp:/oauthredirect?...`).
3. Copy that full address from the browser's address bar and paste it below.

data_description.redirect: The full `com.basicfit.trainingapp:/oauthredirect?code=...` address your browser was sent to after signing in.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-connect your Basic-Fit account
reauth_confirm.description:
Your Basic-Fit login has expired. Sign in again to restore access:

[Sign in to Basic-Fit]({authorize_url})

Then paste the full `com.basicfit.trainingapp:/oauthredirect?...` address below.

data_description.redirect: The full `com.basicfit.trainingapp:/oauthredirect?code=...` address your browser was sent to after signing in.

error.invalid_auth: That address could not be used to sign in. Make sure you pasted the complete redirect address, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Signed in, but could not reach Basic-Fit to read your membership. Please try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This Basic-Fit account is already set up.
abort.unknown_entry: The account to re-authenticate could not be found.
